1. (Currently Amended) A method of providing information regarding a product, the method comprising: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product; and __displaying the at least use information on a user device__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein receiving the unique identifier comprises __using a scanner to read__ the unique identifier from the package.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein receiving the unique identifier comprises __using a reader device to receive__ information stored in a radio frequency identification tag.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: __accessing a data store and__ searching the data store storing at least part of the at least use information using the unique identifier.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 4, wherein searching the data store comprises __using a processor to transmit__ the unique identifier to the data store over a network.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises: receiving at least part of the at least use information in a first form; and __using a processor to convert__ the at least part of the at least use information from the first form to a second form.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: __using a processor to retrieve and receive__ the at least use information from the data store.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the product comprises a pharmaceutical product, and the at least use information comprises at least one of when a next dose of the product is to be taken, when a previous dose of a product was taken, and if a dose of the product is to be taken.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: receiving user information regarding use of the product from __a user through a user device__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein receiving the user information regarding use of the product comprises __using the user device to receive__ an input through a user interface.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein receiving the user information regarding use of the product comprises __using a reader device to receive__ the user information regarding use of the product stored in a radio frequency identification tag.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising __using a processor to receive__ information from a secondary device.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier is stored on at least one of the package, an identification card, an identification bracelet, a user information medium and a list of users.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising __using a processor to provide__ past use information associated with the unique identifier to an authorized individual.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising receiving a user profile, wherein generating the at least use information comprises __using a processor to generate__ the at least use information based at least partially on the user profile.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising __using a processor to generate__ an alert regarding use of the product based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 16, wherein the alert is an escalating alert and wherein the form of the alert escalates with each time no response to the alert is received.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 16, wherein the alert is customized by at least one of a user and an authorized individual.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier comprises a first unique identifier, the method further comprising: reading a second unique identifier identifying __a user of the product__.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 19, further comprising: comparing at least one of a first information type associated with the second unique identifier and the second unique identifier to at least one of the first information type associated with the first unique identifier or a user identifier associated with the first unique identifier; and __using a processor to generate__ a wrong user alert if the at least one of the first information type associated with the second unique identifier and the second unique identifier does not match the at least one of the first information type associated with the first unique identifier or the user identifier associated with the first unique identifier.

21. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 20, further comprising __using a processor to generate__ one or more escalating wrong user alerts when a previous wrong user alert is not acknowledged.

22. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 19, wherein the user comprises a first user and the second unique identifier identifies a second user providing the product to the first user, the method further comprising: storing the second unique identifier in a data store in association with information regarding a particular instance of providing the product to the first user.

23. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 22, wherein generating the at least use information comprises __using a processor to generate__ the at least use information customized to the role of __the second user__.

24. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises __using a processor to generate__ the at least use information of a type customized for __a user of the product__.

25. (Currently Amended) A user device for providing information regarding a product, the user device configured to: receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing the product; __process the unique identifier using a processor__; generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier; __display the at least use information on a display__; and communicate with a data store, the data store storing the user information regarding past use of the product in association with the unique identifier and at least part of the at least use information.

26. (Currently Amended) A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: a computing device configured to: receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; __process the unique identifier using a processor__; generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier; __display the at least use information on a display__; and communicate with a network.

27. (Currently Amended) A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: __a processor configured to receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product__; and __the processor further configured to generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product__.

28. (Currently Amended) A computer readable storage medium on which is embedded one or more computer programs, said one or more computer programs implementing a method of providing information regarding a product, said one or more computer programs comprising a set of instructions for: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; __processing the unique identifier using a processor__; and generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product __and displaying the at least use information on a display__.
